summary: Comprehensive testing of Invoice System for Bathroom Quote Saver.AI - All 17 backend tests passed, frontend UI verified working correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Invoice system properly implements year-based sequential numbering (INV-2026-001, INV-2026-002, etc.)
GST calculation correctly extracts 10% from GST-inclusive amounts
Bank details use placeholder values when env vars not configured - acceptable for MVP
Email sending is MOCKED when SendGrid not configured - marks as sent but doesn't actually send
seed_data_creation: Test invoices created during testing: INV-2026-001 (Draft->Sent), INV-2026-002 (Sent->Paid)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invoice system fully tested. All endpoints working: POST /api/invoices/create-from-stage, GET /api/invoices/list, GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf, PUT /api/invoices/{id}/status, GET /api/contracts/{id}/invoice-status. Frontend Invoices view and Progress Claims UI in Saved Contracts both working correctly.

invoice_creation_from_stage.notes: Creates invoice from contract payment stage, prevents duplicates

invoice_pdf_generation.notes: Generates professional PDF with bank details (placeholder values when env not configured)

invoice_listing.notes: Lists all invoices with optional status/contract filtering

invoice_sequential_numbering.notes: Returns next sequential number in INV-YYYY-NNN format

invoice_status_update.notes: Updates status to sent/paid with timestamps and payment tracking

contract_invoice_status.notes: Returns invoice status for each payment stage of a contract

frontend_invoices_view.notes: Shows invoice list with stats (Total, Sent, Paid, Outstanding), PDF download, Send, Mark Paid buttons

frontend_progress_claims_ui.notes: Shows payment stages in Saved Contracts view, click to create invoice or download existing

email_sending.behavior: Marks invoice as 'sent' but doesn't actually send email. Toast shows 'Invoice marked as sent (email service not configured)'

bank_details.reason: Bank env vars not configured (BANK_NAME, BANK_BSB, BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER)
bank_details.behavior: PDF shows placeholder values for bank details
